image_description: A close-up, cropped view of a dark wood bookcase against a solid blue wall. The image focuses on two visible shelves packed with books. The top shelf contains a stack of horizontal books/magazines. The middle shelf features a row of vertical books with spines facing outward, displaying text in various languages (appearing to be Chinese and English). The bottom shelf is partially visible, showing more books. The lighting is soft, creating slight shadows within the shelf recesses.

artifact_observations.location: Book spines on the middle shelf
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is largely illegible or nonsensical. While some characters resemble Chinese or Latin script, many are malformed, fused, or lack proper kerning/alignment, which is a common AI artifact in rendering text.

artifact_observations.location: Top-left corner of the top shelf
artifact_observations.reasoning: The stack of items on the very top shelf has slightly soft, indistinct edges where it meets the background/shelf back, lacking the crisp geometric definition expected of rigid books.
The books on the partially visible bottom shelf appear to merge slightly with each other and the shadow, lacking distinct separation boundaries.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a generic shelf or cabinet.
To rigorously analyze the legibility and structural correctness of the text on the book spines, which showed signs of gibberish.
To check for fusion between adjacent books and between books and the shelf structure, ensuring distinct physical entities.
To assess general sharpness, lighting consistency, and any subtle generative blurring.

focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of text on book spines
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI images, book spines often fail to render coherent text. If the image_text_auditor confirms high rates of non-character glyphs or fused letters, this significantly impacts the artifact score. Also, verify if the perspective of the shelf lines is consistent with a single vanishing point.
